previous_spine_raw.title: The Mark at the Strongest Point
previous_spine_raw.story_promise: In one dusk-bounded field window, Leyra discovers that a century-sealed gate answers to a road the map denies, finds her mentor's private mark at the strongest point of that response, and must decide what she is willing to put her name to before the light fails.
previous_spine_raw.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer under independent map-seal review, holding authorized exterior survey access to Ashen Gate during a finite field window.
previous_spine_raw.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and complete a record precise enough to survive review, deciding under pressure whether her mentor's private mark enters the official record or stays in her private notes.
previous_spine_raw.central_question: Is Ashen Gate genuinely answering to a road the legal map denies, and what does Leyra owe the record - and her mentor - when the strongest point of the anomaly bears his private mark?
previous_spine_raw.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship; ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world; and what she includes or omits could shape how the guild treats both the anomaly and her mentor.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary without authorization.
A private field mark can establish prior presence or survey activity but cannot prove motive, cause, or a hidden conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must distinguish witnessed response from theory.
The episode must resolve what Leyra can honestly put on record now and leave cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale, and Master Ilyan's motives unresolved.
Do not reveal or assert hidden Saga answers absent from this pack.
previous_spine_raw.opening_hook: Leyra's ward-compass needle swings away from the surveyed boundary line and holds a steady bearing aimed into the sealed Ashen Gate arch - the arch the legal map insists leads nowhere.

logistics_plan.time_window: Late afternoon through dusk: a finite field window during which useful light and stable ward-response conditions fade.
movement_constraints: All surveying is exterior to the sealed boundary; Leyra never crosses through Ashen Gate.
Leyra travels on foot along the exterior survey line between boundary stones.
The return to Greyfen and then Vellum Hall happens after the field window closes.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: The premise grants Leyra authorized exterior access to Ashen Gate during the current field window, and the STANDARD session length supports a single-site investigation with a short return sequence rather than a multi-location tour.

beats.purpose: Open on the anomaly itself: the ward-compass holding a steady bearing into a century-sealed arch.
beats.character_action: Leyra begins the authorized exterior re-survey and notices her ward-compass needle swing to and hold a bearing aimed into the sealed arch.
beats.external_event: Late-afternoon light and stable ward-response conditions begin a finite field window.
beats.new_information: The sealed gate is currently answering to a bearing the legal map records as nonexistent.
beats.escalation_delta: From routine survey to inexplicable instrument response.
beats.state_change: Leyra is no longer performing a routine re-survey; she is witnessing a bounded anomaly candidate.
beats.payoff_contribution: Establishes the raw observation that every later beat refines.

beats.purpose: Ground the anomaly in procedure before escalating.
beats.character_action: Leyra cross-checks the compass against her legal eastern boundary maps and performs a bounded instrument check to rule out simple malfunction.
beats.external_event: The instrument holds steady against every standard correction she applies.
beats.new_information: The response survives a proper instrument check; it is not a simple compass fault.
beats.state_change: The anomaly is now an evidentiary problem rather than an instrument problem.
beats.payoff_contribution: Establishes the evidence quality needed for the later bounded record.

beats.purpose: Show the response is not a single point but a corroborated line.
beats.character_action: Leyra walks the exterior line to a second boundary stone and takes a second reading.
beats.external_event: The second stone gives the same steady bearing into the sealed arch.
beats.new_information: Two independent stones agree; the response is a bounded line, not diffuse residue.
beats.escalation_delta: From a single verified reading to a corroborated pattern.
beats.state_change: The anomaly has a shape; it is something rather than nothing.
beats.payoff_contribution: Provides the corroboration that will make the bounded record meaningful.

beats.purpose: Map the extent and character of the response line.
beats.character_action: Leyra traces the response line to its strongest point using the compass and survey kit, noting its bounds.
beats.external_event: The response line terminates cleanly at both ends; it does not bleed into the surrounding ward-line.
beats.new_information: The response has road-like bounds and a single strongest point near the arch.
beats.state_change: The anomaly is now road-shaped, raising the possibility that a route is pressing against the seal.
beats.payoff_contribution: Defines the bounded extent Leyra will record.

beats.purpose: Introduce the private mark at the point of maximum response.
beats.character_action: At the line's strongest point, Leyra finds an old private survey mark cut into a boundary stone.
beats.external_event: The mark's style and weathering are consistent with Master Ilyan's era and method.
beats.new_information: A private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan sits at the exact spot where the response is strongest; being a private mark, it carries no public account of what its maker found.
beats.escalation_delta: From physical anomaly to personal implication.
beats.state_change: The problem is no longer only the gate; her mentor's unexplained connection to this exact spot is now part of what she has witnessed.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the reversal and the custody choice.

beats.purpose: Reframe the discovery: Leyra is not the first cartographer to work this exact spot, and the person who was there before is her own mentor, who has never accounted for his Ashen Gate work.
beats.character_action: Leyra recognizes the mark as Master Ilyan's and stands at the strongest point of the response knowing that everything he has ever told her about Ashen Gate amounts to avoidance.
beats.external_event: The gate response continues steadily, unaffected by her discovery.
beats.new_information: The strongest point of a road-shaped anomaly bears a private mark from the mentor who has never discussed his Ashen Gate surveys with her; his work here exists in nothing she has been shown or told.
beats.escalation_delta: From discovery to unresolved personal implication.
beats.state_change: Leyra's understanding shifts: this exact spot carries a prior survey history tied to her mentor, whose account of it is absent from everything she knows.
beats.payoff_contribution: Changes what the eventual record means to Leyra personally and defines the custody stakes for the decision.

beats.purpose: Force the choice over what the official record will contain while the light and response window fade.
beats.character_action: Leyra weighs writing the full record - anomaly and mark both - against writing a record of only the gate response and holding the mark in her private notes, as the light fails.
beats.external_event: The useful field light and ward-response window are visibly fading; every minute of deliberation is a minute less to write.
beats.new_information: Leyra recognizes that what she writes decides whether her mentor's connection to this spot becomes institutional evidence or stays her private knowledge.
beats.state_change: The stakes shift from 'what is happening' to 'what she is willing to put her name to'.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets up the climax and the local payoff.

beats.purpose: Resolve the choice into a concrete, precise, dated record completed under Leyra's own name.
beats.character_action: Leyra writes and completes a dated bounded field entry before the light fails: the gate answers to a route the legal map denies, the response is bounded along a single road-like line with a strongest point near the arch, no cause established - with the private mark either included as a witnessed fact of prior survey activity or held in her private notes, per her decision.
beats.external_event: The light fails to survey-grade shortly after she finishes writing.
beats.new_information: The record is complete and independently Leyra's; it does not claim the gate is open and does not interpret the mark beyond what it can prove.
beats.escalation_delta: From choice to irreversible local action.
beats.state_change: The anomaly now exists as a formal, bounded, dated record under Leyra's name, with the mark's custody settled by her choice.
beats.payoff_contribution: Delivers the local payoff's evidentiary core.

beats.purpose: Convert the record into community consequence without overstatement.
beats.character_action: Leyra brings the bounded record to the Greyfen ward-keepers, stating only what she witnessed and requesting formal authorization to investigate further.
beats.external_event: The ward-keepers treat the record as a concrete reason to watch the old boundary and consider petitioning for a formal re-survey.
beats.new_information: Greyfen now has a carefully-worded, concrete reason to monitor the boundary; the guild must decide whether to authorize a re-survey.
beats.escalation_delta: From personal record to institutional consequence.
beats.state_change: The anomaly is now a matter of record for both village and guild.
beats.payoff_contribution: Delivers the local payoff's community consequence.

beats.purpose: Return the question to the mentor without resolving it.
beats.character_action: Leyra returns to Vellum Hall where Master Ilyan receives or reviews her bounded record.
beats.external_event: Ilyan's reaction is guarded; he asks no questions that would explain his earlier work and offers none that would explain the gate.
beats.new_information: Ilyan's guarded reaction to a record about Ashen Gate makes his long avoidance of the subject a visible, present choice rather than a background absence.
beats.escalation_delta: From institutional consequence to unresolved personal tension.
beats.state_change: The mentor relationship state shifts from 'unresolved gap' to 'visible unresolved choice'.
beats.payoff_contribution: Leaves the personal question open while the institutional question moves forward.

escalation_ladder: A routine re-survey produces an instrument reading that should not exist.
A second independent stone corroborates the response, ruling out simple instrument fault.
The response proves road-like in bounds, implying structure rather than random residue.
A private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan sits exactly at the response's strongest point.
The mark establishes that her mentor worked this exact spot before her, with no account of it in anything she has been shown or told.
Fading light forces an immediate choice over what her official record will contain.
The bounded record makes the anomaly a matter of institutional review and visible personal tension.

reversal.prior_belief: Leyra initially believes she has encountered a fresh, undocumented anomaly that she is the first to properly witness.

evidence.claim: A private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan's era and method is cut into the stone where the boundary response is strongest.
The mark establishes that Master Ilyan surveyed or marked this exact spot in the past; as a private mark carrying no public account, his work here appears in nothing Leyra has been shown or told.

reversal.reinterpretation: Leyra is not the first cartographer to work this exact spot. Her mentor surveyed or marked the strongest point of this boundary response at some point in the past, and has never given her any account of his Ashen Gate work.
reversal.inference_ceiling: The mark proves prior presence and survey activity by Ilyan at this spot. It does not prove what he observed, what he concluded, why he left a private mark rather than a public record, whether the boundary was responding then as it is now, or that he acted wrongly in any way.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: What Master Ilyan actually witnessed or concluded at Ashen Gate, and whether the boundary was behaving this way when he was here.

decision_point.pressure: Dusk and the fading ward-response window are closing in; whatever Leyra writes must be written now, and she must choose whether her mentor's private mark enters the official record or stays in her private notes - a choice that decides whose hands the full truth lands in.

branches.option: Write the complete bounded record now - the gate response, the corroborated line, and the private mark as a witnessed fact of prior survey activity - on her own apprentice authority, forgoing any further reproduction testing as the light fails.
branches.immediate_action: Use the survey kit and field log to write a dated, bounded entry covering the gate response, the road-like bounds, and the mark's presence and position, wording the mark entry as observed fact without interpretation.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Leyra holds her own dated bounded record containing both the anomaly and the mark; her mentor's connection to the spot becomes part of the official evidence trail.
branches.cost_or_risk: The fuller entry consumes more of the failing window, so it must be written in worse light with no time left to reproduce the response from a third position; it also invites guild scrutiny of Ilyan on a subject the record cannot resolve, and could read as an apprentice overstepping during map-seal review.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Establishes Leyra as an independent evidentiary voice willing to record uncomfortable facts; risks making her mentor relationship adversarial, since his avoided subject becomes institutional material she put there.
branches.climax_requirement: Leyra must produce a record precise enough that even a hostile reviewer cannot dismiss it, while wording the mark entry so it establishes prior survey activity without implying motive, knowledge, or suppression - a direct test of her maps-must-earn-truth principle.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: The guild receives evidence containing both the anomaly and the mark, forcing a formal re-survey decision and putting the mentor question on institutional record; Leyra proves she can document uncomfortable facts without overclaiming.

branches.option: Write a bounded record of only the gate response - the compass readings, the two-stone corroboration, the road-like bounds - and keep the private mark in her personal notes rather than the official record.
branches.immediate_action: Use the survey kit and field log to write a dated, bounded entry covering only the gate response, then note the mark separately in the private pages of her field log.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Leyra holds her own dated bounded record of the anomaly, but the official record omits the mark; the prior-survey fact remains only in her private knowledge.
branches.cost_or_risk: The official record is incomplete; if anyone else later finds the mark, Leyra's credibility suffers for having omitted a relevant observation from a survey she signed, and her own maps-must-earn-truth principle is strained by the withholding.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Spares Ilyan immediate institutional scrutiny and preserves their working relationship on the surface, but places Leyra in quiet conflict with her own evidentiary principles and gives her a secret from the guild.
branches.climax_requirement: Leyra must produce a record precise enough to survive review while knowingly excluding a relevant observation, and must carry the tension of that omission as she writes under the same failing light.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: The guild receives a clean, bounded anomaly record that can support a formal re-survey decision, while the mentor question stays private and unresolved - Leyra keeps control of the personal thread at the cost of an incomplete official record.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Why the boundary is answering, what Ilyan concluded years ago, and how the guild will weigh a record written solely under an apprentice's name.

previous_spine_raw.climax: Before the light fails, Leyra independently completes a precise, dated, bounded field record under her own name: Ashen Gate answers to a route the legal map denies, the response is bounded along a single road-like line with a strongest point near the arch, and no cause is established. Per her custody choice, the private mark either enters the record as a witnessed fact of prior survey activity or is set aside in her private notes; in either case she does not claim the gate is open and does not interpret the mark beyond what it can prove.
previous_spine_raw.local_payoff: The episode resolves with a bounded Ashen Gate anomaly on record under Leyra's name - its contents reflecting her custody choice - a Greyfen reason to monitor the old boundary, and a mentor silence that is now a visible choice rather than a background gap. Cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale, and Master Ilyan's motives remain unresolved.
previous_spine_raw.forward_hook: Leyra's bounded record forces a formal guild decision on whether Ashen Gate warrants re-survey, while Master Ilyan's guarded reaction to the record leaves the question of what he knows open on the table between them - and, if she kept the mark private, her own knowledge of it becomes a weight only she carries.

anti_repetition_signature.core_problem_shape: Distinguishing a real boundary change from magical residue under time pressure while a trusted mentor's unaccounted prior presence complicates what the official record should contain.
anti_repetition_signature.primary_activity: Exterior field surveying with instrument cross-checks, bounded field recording, and a custody choice over the record's contents.
anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Single primary exterior site (Ashen Gate exterior survey stones) for eight of ten beats, with a brief payoff scene at Greyfen and a short tag scene at Vellum Hall as a return bookend; the episode is a deep single-site investigation, not a multi-location tour.
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: A race against fading light to produce a precise bounded record whose contents reflect a custody choice, rather than a confrontation or escape.

writer_rules: Dramatize the beat plan; do not invent causal bridges, hidden answers, or evidence not established by the spine.
Never assert why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or what Master Ilyan concluded; these remain absent from the pack and must stay absent.

The private field mark proves only prior presence and survey activity; do not let Leyra or the prose conclude that Ilyan witnessed the current anomaly, suppressed it, or acted wrongly - his silence about his Ashen Gate work is fact, his knowledge of this response is not.
Leyra may not cross the sealed boundary at any point; all surveying and observation is exterior.

Every magical response must be traceable to rule-bound cartographic logic: the ward-compass answers witnessed boundary lines, the response is bounded, and instrument cross-checks precede any claim being treated as evidence.
Keep the record's wording bounded throughout: distinguish witnessed response from inference, and never let Leyra or the prose claim the gate is open or explain the change.
Dusk and the fading ward-response window must function as real time pressure shaping the custody choice, not as decorative atmosphere.
Master Ilyan's reaction at the tag must remain guarded and unexplained; do not have him confirm, deny, or explain his earlier mark or his Ashen Gate work.
Both decision branches must end with Leyra independently completing her own dated bounded record in prose; neither branch may hand the record's completion to another character.
